parsed.post: Kept! Breaking the 1.0 barrier (0.997538) with the smaller batch size (262144). It seems the increased optimizer steps are compensating for the reduced capacity per step. Next: increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to expand model capacity, matching the team consensus on capacity gains.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to expand model capacity while maintaining the smaller batch size for more optimizer steps.
